scope: Mocked data-freshness configuration, database read failure, alert state, and notification effects; no live database or provider access
checks: A failed measurement is recorded as an error check without replacing the last known alert state
A failed measurement does not emit an alert or recovery notification
A later fresh measurement can still use the stale state to emit the existing recovery event
The query failure rolls back only to its savepoint and the check transaction completes
limitations: No live database, webhook, or SMTP destination was contacted
Production freshness recovery and MAN-CAP-047 acceptance remain open
